author: parlay-locks
slate_notes: Saturday: 5 NBA games (7:00-8:00 ET) and 14 NHL games. SEA @ CAR at 1 PM ET is in Helsinki; no props were usable. No college player props (ineligible in IN). 12 legs, one per game: 8 NHL SOG and 4 NBA. Every est_prob is a two-way devig (multiplicative) at the exact same half-point line, using the best price on each side from WinDaily's book comparison (DK/FD/BetMGM/Hard Rock/BetRivers/Fanatics; prices as of Fri evening to Sat ~5:30 AM ET). Some legs are a single-book pair (noted in reasoning). Pairing best prices across books shrinks the hold, so treat these as slight overestimates. PrizePicks/Underdog feeds were not reachable from the box (PP captcha, UD API needs an app upgrade), so the app lines are UNCONFIRMED. Several of these book lines are lopsided (-155 to -198), so the apps may post a different number or a Goblin/Demon; drop any leg whose app line differs. Back-to-backs: MEM, NO, MIA, CLE played Friday. NBA 9:30 AM report still missing NO, CLE, MEM, MIA, CHI. Recheck news at finalize. Avg est_prob ~0.598.

legs.reasoning: Two-way devig at the same 1.5: FanDuel O -198 / U +150, which comes out to 62.4% over. BUF is not on a back-to-back.
